forWhat: Who teaches which class and subject. A person's pages open on their own classes.

layout.shows: A form for name, school email and role.
Person, Role, Classes they teach and Subjects they teach. A cell opens to tick classes or subjects.

jobs.title: Add a member of staff
steps: Type their name, school email and role. Press [[Add and send a link]].
They get an email with a link to set their password. It works once and lasts {t:password_link.first_days} days.
Then open their row, tick their classes and press [[Save the classes]].

jobs.title: Change who teaches a class
steps: Open the person's classes, tick the ones they teach and press [[Save the classes]].
For subjects, tick them and press [[Save the subjects]].

buttons.label: Add and send a link
buttons.does: Adds the person and emails them a link to set their password.
buttons.doesNot: Nobody types a password for them.

buttons.label: Save the classes
buttons.does: Saves which classes the person teaches.
buttons.doesNot: A class with no child in it cannot be chosen.
